name: Alt text import CSV
description: Bulk-updates image/media alt texts from an uploaded CSV file (page URL, image URL, alt text).
project_description:
Features 
 This module allows mass updating of alt texts on images, by uploading a prepared CSV file.

 CSV files must be in the format:

 

Page URL, Image URL, Alt text

 

 The module can optionally send email reports detailing any CSV rows which have failed to import. 

 Post-Installation 
 Configure sending of email reports at Administration » Configuration » Media » Alt text CSV import .

 To update alt texts:

 
 Go to Administration » Configuration » Media 
 Upload the CSV file. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 Multi-value form element 
 Back to top
